name: Mount Generic - VEI 4 Plinian reference eruption
description: Default reference scenario approximating a sub-Plinian to Plinian eruption of a 2800 m stratovolcano. Parameters chosen to be physically representative of a VEI 4 event (e.g. comparable in scale to Eyjafjallajokull 2010 or Pinatubo precursor activity).

notes.vent_velocity: Exit velocity at the vent in m/s; Plinian eruptions 150-400 m/s
notes.heim_coefficient: H/L energy-line ratio for PDC runout; 0.2-0.3 typical for mobile flows
notes.collapse_height: Height of column collapse above vent (m); drives PDC energy budget
notes.wind: Mean tropospheric wind vector [vx, vy, vz] m/s controlling ash dispersal
